overall: Board violated the Open Meeting Law by having a quorum deliberate outside a posted meeting about reorganizing its leadership, and by posting notices with insufficiently detailed topics. Ordered compliance and member training.

allegations.summary: Complainant alleged the Board held unposted decision-making meetings before a March 2, 2011 vote to reorganize the Board and remove complainant as chair.
Complainant alleged the notice for the March 2, 2011 meeting was not posted in accordance with the Open Meeting Law; the Board's notices often listed topics without specificity.
allegations.key_passage: we find that the Board failed to post sufficiently detailed notices for its meetings on several occasions prior to March 2, 2011

remedy: Immediate and future compliance with the Open Meeting Law, G.L. c. 30A, §§18-25. Any future similar violation may be considered an intentional violation.

Attendance at a training on the Open Meeting Law and certification to this Office that every member of the Board has attended that training, conducted by an attorney or organization familiar with the Law and approved by this Office.
